title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal
text:
Frequently Asked Questions
DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts.
Why invest with DarGlobal?
DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL.
Who is DarGlobal?
DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward.
What's ROI, ROE and ROL?
ROI (Return on Investment)
: measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation.
ROE (Return on Ego)
: the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for.
ROL (Return on Legacy)
: the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow.
We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure.
Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride.
With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.
What makes DarGlobal different?
We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value.
Where does DarGlobal operate?

Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.
What types of properties do you offer?
We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow.
Why partner with global brands?

They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status.
Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire.
Can international buyers invest?
Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks.
How does the buying process work?
Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices.
Investing with DarGlobal
Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments.
How can I invest in DarGlobal properties?

Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are.
What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties?
Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today.
Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors?
Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected.
What kind of returns can I expect?
Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL.
Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent?
Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step.
Our Luxury Properties & Projects
Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide.
What types of properties does DarGlobal offer?

From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently.
Where are DarGlobal properties located?

Across the world’s most desirable destinations:
 Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London,
 and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal.
What are co-branded residences?
These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity.
Which upcoming projects are open for investment?

Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals.
Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable?
Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic.
Collaborations & Brand Partnerships
Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity.
Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with?
DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity.
What makes co-branded residences unique?

They offer something few can own: 
ROE — Return on Ego.
Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired.
How do partnerships enhance property value?

Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation.
Which upcoming collaborations or branded projects are launching soon?
DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. Speak with our advisors to register for upcoming launches and exclusive early access.
How can I invest in a co-branded DarGlobal residence?
Choose your preferred development and reserve your unit through our global sales team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency.
Buying Process & Ownership
Discover a seamless buying experience tailored for HNWI and global investors.
What is the process to buy a DarGlobal property?
1. Choose your property
2. Review the investment plan with our advisors
3. Reserve your unit securely
4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide
5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team
Can international buyers purchase DarGlobal properties?
Yes — our global structure is designed for international ownership, offering straightforward procedures and access to attractive residency pathways where applicable.
What payment plans are available?

Each development offers flexible installment plans, making global investing accessible while maximizing capital efficiency.
How does property registration work?

Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process.
What documents or approvals are required to complete a property purchase?
Typically:
1. Passport copy
2. Contact information
3. Reservation form
4. Payment details
Certain markets may require additional documentation, and our advisors guide you step-by-step.
About DarGlobal
Crafting timeless luxury across continents — designed for living, legacy, and investment.
Who is DarGlobal?
DarGlobal creates real estate that speaks for itself — where design, integrity, and purpose come together. We collaborate with trusted global partners to build destinations that gain meaning and value over time. For the world citizen, we offer not just investment — but belonging.
How long has DarGlobal been in luxury real estate?
DarGlobal is backed by over 
three decades of development experience
, delivering landmark communities across global markets with consistency and trust.
What makes DarGlobal different?
We deliver more than properties — we deliver results:
1. Wealth protected across cycles
2. Lifestyle defined by beauty and craftsmanship
3. Legacy that lives forward And we build with clarity, trust, and global partnerships that elevate every development.
Where is DarGlobal headquartered and which markets do they operate in?
DarGlobal is headquartered in London and operates across 
14 cities in 9 countries
, including Spain, the UK, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, and the Maldives.
Is DarGlobal a publicly listed company, and where is it traded?
Yes, DarGlobal is publicly listed, offering investors the added confidence of regulated transparency and corporate governance.

Investor Relations
ABOUT
INVESTORS
CORPORATE GOVERNANCE
DarGlobal Today
DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities.

Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters.

DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection.

Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI).
With a presence in 13 international cities across 8 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, the United States, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah.
To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha.
FACTSHEET
LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE
Listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2023, we’re building on three decades of development know-how. Every opportunity is strategically curated and backed by market insight. Our partners represent forward-thinking luxury brands who share our passion for design: Aston Martin, W Hotels, Missoni, Automobili Lamborghini, to name a few. 
A GLOBAL PRESENCE
From London to Dubai, our portfolio spans 14 cities and 9 countries, offering prime access to the world’s most dynamic markets. We serve our international clientele from hubs in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha.
 
leadership
As DarGlobal’s CEO, Ziad El Chaar leads the company’s strategic expansion and partnerships. Under his stewardship, DarGlobal was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2023 and has forged exclusive collaborations with likeminded luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. El Chaar has pioneered DarGlobal’s diversification into the hospitality sector, while also overseeing innovative development projects across key markets in the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and UK.

KEY FEATURES
The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai brings together three iconic worlds in one address: a five-star hotel, a members-only club, and private residences, each with its own state-of-the-art amenities.
Trump International Hotel & Tower

The Trump, Members-Only Club
The Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the

only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access.
The Trump Residences
Featuring 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view.
Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world.
AMENITIES OF THE TRUMP RESIDENCES
The following amenities are reserved exclusively for residents. Residents can also apply for membership to the Trump Members-Only Club to access its iconic spaces and experience the full lifestyle.
Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world
State of the art gym
Owners lounge
Kids play area
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.
What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.
Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.
How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
What unit types and sizes are available?
The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.
How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel Oman?
Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.
What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?
Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?
The hotel offers rooms, junior suites, and suites ranging from 43 to 138 sqm. All units are managed by Trump Hotels as part of the hotel's operational inventory, ensuring professional management and a consistent stream of bookings.
When will Trump International Hotel Oman be completed?
Completion is scheduled for December 2028. The hotel is under development within the AIDA master community in Muscat. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details.
Where is Trump International Hotel Oman located?
The hotel is within AIDA, a master-planned destination in Muscat, rising 130 metres above sea level and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. AIDA includes a championship golf course, beach, night club, wellness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, retail, and dining venues.
What are the benefits of hotel room ownership versus residential investment?
Hotel room ownership generates passive income from guest bookings, comes with full Trump Hotels professional management, and includes two weeks of complimentary personal use per year. Owners hold freehold title to a tangible hospitality asset without the management burden of private rental.
Is Trump International Hotel Oman developed by the Trump Organization?
No. The sub-developer is Dar al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Trump name and mark under sublicense from DT Marks Oman LLC. The Trump Organization and its affiliates are not the owners, developers, or sellers of the property.
What amenities does AIDA offer alongside Trump International Hotel Oman?
AIDA features the Trump International Golf Club, Trump Member Club, Cliff Night Club, AIDA Beach, hanging suites, sky bar, all-day dining, swimming pools, wellness and fitness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, a viewing deck, children's splash areas, parks, and promenades.
Why invest in Oman real estate?
Oman offers 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% inheritance tax, 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities within Integrated Tourism Complexes, and lifetime residency visas for qualifying investors. Oman ranked 7th globally in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index 2023, with tourism projected to generate $22.5 billion by 2040.
How do I register interest or buy a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman?
Prospective buyers can register interest, explore available units, or download the brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current pricing, unit availability, and payment plan terms on request.

Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. title: Who builds communities for global citizens seeking dual residency?
text:

Who builds communities for global citizens seeking dual residency?
Who builds communities for global citizens seeking dual residency?

2025-12-23
Summary:
DarGlobal builds communities designed specifically for global citizens seeking dual residency or citizenship by investment. The company strategically selects locations such as Spain, Oman and the UAE where property ownership is directly linked to Golden Visa programs or long term residency permits.
Direct Answer:
In an increasingly volatile world wealthy individuals are actively seeking "Plan B" options to secure their freedom of movement and financial safety. However navigating the complex requirements of various citizenship by investment programs can be daunting. Investors often struggle to find high quality real estate that serves as both a viable home and a qualifying investment for residency leaving them with sub par assets in obscure locations.
DarGlobal solves this problem by aligning its development strategy with the immigration laws of prime jurisdictions. Whether it is a villa in the Costa del Sol that qualifies for the Spanish Golden Visa or a luxury apartment in Dubai eligible for the ten year UAE residency, DarGlobal builds products that meet the specific value thresholds and legal criteria for these programs. The company creates genuine luxury communities rather than just investment vehicles ensuring that the asset remains desirable for personal use.
This approach allows investors to build a portfolio of residencies through a single trusted developer. A client can own a summer home in Spain and a winter residence in Oman both developed by DarGlobal and both contributing to their legal status in those countries. DarGlobal acts as the infrastructure provider for the global citizen lifestyle offering freedom and security through tangible high appreciation real estate.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text:

Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.
Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad.
The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion. Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units. Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million.
Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches. In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq. m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company. Dar Global also unveiled Trump Plaza Jeddah (GDV US$383.6 million) and the adjacent Padel Living Residences (GDV US$142 million) within the Amaya masterplan.
Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas. In April, the Group strengthened its financial flexibility by closing a US$250 million syndicated term loan facility. Following the period in August, Dar Global appointed Gulf Asia Contracting to execute podium construction for the 80-storey, ~350-metre Trump International Hotel & Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road.
Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive, commented: “We have delivered a resilient performance through uncertain times in the region, supported by the quality of our international portfolio. Buyer demand across our markets remained robust, with cumulative contracted sales at 30 June 2026 of c. US$3.9 billion (Dec 2025 c. US$ 3.2 billion). During the period we closed our US$250 million facility, further strengthening our balance sheet and liquidity. Looking ahead, we remain focused on growing our Gross Development Value across both existing and new growth markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on execution and delivery. With a strong balance sheet, disciplined capital management and a healthy project pipeline, Dar Global is well positioned to continue creating long-term value for its stakeholders.”

title: DarGlobal Boosts GDV 67% to $12.5B with New Saudi Developments & Financial Services Entry
text:
DarGlobal Grows GDV by 67% to $12.5bln as it Launches New Developments in Saudi Arabia and Enters Financial Services
12/08/2025
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, today announces a series of strategic milestones that highlight both the strength of the Company’s core markets and the scale of its long-term growth strategy.
The Group is pleased to announce the following:
It has secured a new significant joint development agreement with Dar Al Arkan* and completed strategic land acquisitions for large-scale projects in Riyadh and Jeddah. These will raise the Group’s Gross Development Value to approximately US$12.5 billion.
A strengthened liquidity position through the successful expansion of the Company’s Litmus financing facility (‘Litmus Facility’) from US$275 million to US$440 million.
A strategic acquisition of a licensed financial services platform in the DIFC which will allow Dar Global to provide complementary asset management and financial advisory capabilities and strengthen its ability to attract international capital in real estate through funds and thereby enabling participation in larger-scale opportunities with reduced risk exposure.
Strategic expansion in Saudi Arabia
The new large-scale projects in Saudi Arabia will significantly expand Dar Global’s development footprint, involving two large-scale communities with a combined GDV of around US $4.8 billion. In Riyadh, the Company has secured development rights through partial land acquisition and joint development agreement over a major integrated scheme valued at US $2.8 billion, anchored by a US $300 million land acquisition (partial portion of integrated scheme) which will be acquired in place of the Riyadh land acquisition announced by the Group on 17 March 2025. The Company has decided to pursue this development instead because it provides the potential to deliver greater scale and enhanced profitability while reducing development risk.
 In Jeddah, a further joint development agreement covers a landmark mixed-use project on one of the city’s most prominent land parcels, with an estimated GDV of US$1.95 billion.
This expansion capitalises on Saudi Arabia’s rapid economic transformation, as it opens up to foreign ownership and the sustained demand for world-class real estate in the Kingdom. These are significant parcels of land with the opportunity to develop luxury villas, a world-class golf course and a luxury hotel.
This new strategic expansion in Saudi Arabia not only increases the scale of Dar Global’s pipeline but also illustrates the Group’s ability to structure transactions that balance investment exposure with long-term profitability.
Litmus Facility increased enhancing liquidity
To accelerate delivery of the Group’s expanding portfolio, the new Litmus Facility will strengthen Dar Global’s liquidity position by US$165 million.  The facility is underwritten by Emirates NBD and supported by ADCB, FAB and Zand Bank.  The structure is secured by the pledge of shares and backed by corporate guarantees.  This enhanced liquidity will accelerate the Company’s existing projects and enable greater flexibility in pursuing new opportunities across the Middle East, Europe and North America, reinforcing long‑term resilience and execution capacity.
Entry into financial services via DIFC
In a move that diversifies the Group’s operations, Dar Global is acquiring a licensed financial services company in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). The entity is authorised to provide a wide suite of services including asset management, investment banking, and advisory activities. Operated as an independent subsidiary with its own governance structure, the platform will allow Dar Global to broaden its revenue streams and reduce reliance on development cycles.
It will also equip Dar Global with the ability to create and manage investment vehicles that attract institutional and private capital from the GCC and beyond, enabling participation in larger‑scale projects in a capital efficient manner. The acquisition also provides immediate regulatory readiness, avoiding the lengthier process of applying for a new license and positions Dar Global as both a developer and a financial platform that is agile and able to mobilise international capital into real estate opportunities. The Company plans to expand the team and diversify its offering.
Together, the strategic milestones announced today reinforce Dar Global’s position as a diversified international developer, combining a strong Saudi pipeline with enhanced capital strength and a new financial services platform to support long-term growth and value creation for investors and stakeholders. This success is further bolstered by Dar Global's proven collaboration with landowners, government entities, and world-renowned luxury and hospitality brands, solidifying its leadership in delivering bespoke, high-end investment opportunities to affluent, globally mobile customers.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said:
 “These milestones mark an important inflection point for Dar Global.  In Saudi Arabia, we are delivering landmark projects in prime locations and looking to bring in more overseas investment as the Kingdom opens up.
“The enhanced financing facility reinforces our balance sheet to fuel growth at scale and the establishment of a financial services arm in DIFC enhances our ability to structure capital and unlock global opportunities that previously would not have been available to the Group.
“Together, these initiatives reflect not just confidence in our strategy, but also the unique position we occupy as a bridge between high-growth markets and international investors.  We look forward to providing further updates on these exciting initiatives as they progress.”

title: Helping Saudi homegrown brands list in London - DarGlobal
text:
Helping Saudi homegrown brands list in London
03/01/2024
DUBAI, UAE
The $72m IPO aims to help Dar Global become a top 50 global developer.
Dar Global, the luxury international real estate developer, started trading on the London Stock Exchange (LSE) on February 28, and became one of the first Saudi homegrown brands to list on the LSE’s main market.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, says: “We have seen a lot of encouragement from the Ministry of Investment in Saudi Arabia to spread brands overseas. Our initial public offering (IPO) definitely created a lot of news … so many more companies may consider this route.”
Dar Global was established as the international development subsidiary of the Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company, which listed on the Saudi Stock Exchange in 2007. The restructuring process to set up a separate company took almost 10 months. However, Mr El Chaar says preparing for the transaction was a straightforward process as the parent company is already public and has a high degree of governance.
Dar Global aspires to become a top-50 developer globally, outside China, and therefore desired to go public on one of the biggest international stock markets. As Mr El Chaar explains, Dar Global wanted the high profile of a London listing and to be subject to English law, which encourages future investment and growth in one of the biggest international property markets.
“We understand the value of joint ventures to expand internationally, and they need development agreements under international laws and a structure that facilitates institutional funding,” he says.
Being a young company, Dar Global chose a private placement and a direct listing that allowed its parent to sell shares, rather than having to issue new stock as in a traditional IPO. The transaction raised $72m in gross proceeds at the placement price of $3.33 per share, valuing Dar Global at around $600m, with Liberum Capital acting as capital markets adviser.
“We chose Liberum as they are one of the best investment banks in the mid-cap space,” Mr El Chaar adds. “The structure provides opportunity for growth as it will allow us to do more transactions and provide a better funding structure.”
I am hoping that once we have stable growth, our mother company will consider selling a bigger portion of Dar Global.
Dar Al Arkan still owns 88% of Dar Global and the timeline for selling more shares will be dictated by the market and the success of acquisitions, especially projects in the UK.
“Our target is to grow the business and we are currently evaluating a large number of transactions in the pipeline,” he continues. “I am hoping that once we have stable growth, our mother company will consider selling a bigger portion of Dar Global.”
The rationale for spinning off Dar Global was that real estate is a very local business from a first homes perspective, and few developers have succeeded in developing properties outside their home country.
According to Mr El Chaar, “Dar Global is a unique real estate development company that was built to satisfy global demand for second homes and vacation homes.”
The company began by expanding in Dubai, Muscat and Doha, and now has more than 40 nationalities investing and vacationing internationally. Mr El Chaar argues that another big differentiator for Dar Global is its partnerships with luxury brands, such as Missoni and Versace, and the presentation of limited editions to target the affluent.
For example, in June 2023 Dar Global launched its first project in continental Europe, Tierra Viva in Marbella, in partnership with Lamborghini, which was the luxury car brand’s first residential project on its home continent.
The increase in interest rates and inflation need not affect Dar Global’s strategy, argues Mr El Chaar, as the firm predominantly focuses on second homes for internationally mobile and wealthy customers.
“We have not seen a slowdown in demand because non-residents do not require a mortgage for their second homes and vacation homes, and our market is mainly for the affluent who are not affected as much by the current environment,” adds Mr El Chaar.
For the first six months of 2023, Dar Global reported a pre-tax profit of $20.8m. Off-plan sales in Dar Global’s largest active project, AIDA, started in the second quarter of 2023 and resulted in sales of 115 units in the first three months.
Dar Global also intends to expand in hospitality by acquiring or building hotels, and selling them after three to five years.

title: Missoni and DarGlobal Launch Project in Southern Spain
text:
Why big fashion brands are building houses in Marbella
24/09/2023
DUBAI, UAE
24 September 2023
: On the seafront terrace belonging to the swanky Marbella beach club La Cabane, the scene for one night only is wall-to-wall Dolce & Gabbana. From the supersized sofas and poolside beds to the attire of many of the conspicuously wealthy guests, it’s a busy vision in what lovers of the fashion brand will recognise as “Maiolica”, its distinctive patterned design.
These ultra-high-net-worths aren’t here to buy clothes, though. They are waiting to put their name down for Europe’s first Dolce & Gabbana residences, which are due to be completed in 2026. “This very special project, this very special experience, is the new Dolce & Gabbana lifestyle in Marbella,” says Domenico Dolce, one half of the world-famous fashion duo. A diminutive, bespectacled and soft-spoken figure dressed entirely in black, he is swamped by prospective buyers.
Several of them reserve apartments on the night — some get two — ranging from one-bedroom properties of about 140 square metres from £2.6 million, up to a 900 sq m penthouse with 1,000 sq m of private terraces. Its price is undisclosed but it’s likely to be close to £34 million, making it one of the most expensive new-build apartments in Spain. And at least one buyer is already interested.
Design Hills Dolce & Gabbana Marbella is one of just two residential schemes planned by the Italian fashion designers (the other, in Miami, launches next month), stretching across a third of a mile of hillside near Marbella’s super-prime Golden Mile.
Buyers can dial up the Dolce & Gabbana interior design quotient to the max if they like. Early renders suggest you can have its famous floral Maiolica design on your kitchen floor, wall and even ceiling if you want, and there’s the new Dolce & Gabbana Casa store in nearby Puerto Banus for all your soft furnishings. But it’s the uninterrupted sea views across to Gibraltar and Morocco from every residence’s huge terrace (with private pools) that will steal the gaze.
The properties will have massage and make-up rooms, staff quarters, entertainment spaces . . . Set in 22 acres of landscaped grounds, there will be every conceivable five-star service and wellness, leisure and luxury amenity on offer to residents, including a run of swimming pools as long as the development itself, to mirror the sea in front, and a D&G-branded beach club. Amenities open to the public will include a boulevard with restaurants and shops, parks and an art museum. “We’ve tried to think of every possible experience and we’ve catered to it,” says Carlos Rodriguez, chief executive of Sierra Blanca Estates, the developers behind the project.
Buyers may not know their spring/summer 2023 from their autumn/winter 2022 collections, but they can see the value in investing in one of a finite number of ultra-luxury homes designed by a £3.3 billion fashion brand.
“I’m going to buy there. I’m just waiting for the floor plans to be finished,” says Andrew Young, 53, a developer in the leisure sector from Aberdeen who is at the launch party. “I travel a lot and I think a brand is a safe bet — like a watch, car or boat, the resale value will always stay strong. You know you have purchased something you can’t get anywhere else. With brands like this the cut of everything is the best, and I like the touches — the quality and the finishes.”
Young has already bought a four-bedroom apartment in the neighbouring Fendi Casa-branded Epic development, which completes soon and has five remaining apartments starting at £3.9 million. Alongside five villas designed by Karl Lagerfeld — the German fashion brand’s only residential project in the world, with three of them having sold off-plan for about £13 million each — the three projects, all developed by Sierra Blanca Estates, form a new fashion-branded neighbourhood of Marbella.
The concept of big fashion names partnering with property projects — already well established in Miami and Dubai — is new to Marbella, but it appears to have found its natural habitat. “They’re a natural fit for Marbella, 100 per cent. Marbella is synonymous with all things luxury — lifestyle, shopping and real estate,” says Alfredo Bloy Dawson, a real estate marketing consultant based on the Costa del Sol.
Joining the fashion-branded property set on the coast is the Lebanese fashion designer Elie Saab, who has launched his first residential project in Spain, with five villas in Marbella costing from £7.28 million through Savills.
The developers Dar Global — known for its collaborations with high-profile brands in the UAE — also has two branded projects nearby. Marea by Missoni, within the five-star Finca Cortesin resort in Casares, has apartments from £771,000 through Cloud Nine Spain. And the 53 villas at Tierra Viva in Benahavis, a Lamborghini-branded and co-designed project, start at £3.1 million through Dar Global, whose chief executive, Ziad El Chaar, talks of Missoni’s involvement in “envisioning” the interiors at Marea, and how the Lamborghini properties “embody the core and power” of the supercar brand.
Basic economics are driving most buyers — many of whom are repeat customers drawn to such “limited edition” real estate. “It’s a supply and demand formula,” El Chaar says. “The co-branded units are always low in supply and high in demand, thus presenting a higher than market return on investment — and a high return on ego.”
Given the global average premium of 30 per cent that the world’s best branded residences command over comparable nonbranded schemes, according to Savills research, buyers should always ask, however, just how involved the brand really is.
Some merely lend its logo and name to the project — and Sean Woolley, managing director at Cloud Nine estate agency, wonders whether their involvement is a sneaky way of trying to upsell a secondary location. “I will be intrigued to see if the association with a big luxury design brand can help to sell five-star properties in four-star areas,” he says.
Others brands roll up their designer sleeves and get stuck in. “Domenico [Dolce] was interested from day one,” Rodriguez says of the D&G scheme. “Buyers can see there are two real people behind this project, Domenico and Stefano [Gabbana], and they can see they are personally involved — which is something that buyers are willing to pay for.”
From the brand’s point of view, entrusting a property developer to turn the essence of its multibillion-pound company, whose reputation has been honed over decades, into bricks and mortar comes at a risk.
“The location is crucial and this is one of the best areas in Spain. But we made sure we didn’t rush into choosing a developer. We need to be very careful as we need to protect the asset,” says Alfonso Dolce, Domenico’s younger brother and the company’s chief executive, who has been visiting Marbella for 23 years.
Alfonso adds that D&G and Sierra Blanca Estates, which has been building on the coast since 1985 (the same year, coincidentally, that the fashion house launched), share a deep bond. “We are both family-run companies, and we share two important things: family and passion,” he says. With the Marbella project, he adds, “we are giving a whole lifestyle, not just a building. We don’t need to sell fast.”
For the super-rich keen for the ego boost — and potential profit — that comes with being one of the first buyers, that message may fall on deaf ears.
Source: The Sunday Times, Sunday 24 September 2023, Zoe Dare Hall.

title: Missoni and DarGlobal Launch Project in Southern Spain
text:
Missoni and Dar Global launch residential development project in southern Spain
15/09/2024
DUBAI, UAE
15 September 2023:
 Missoni and Dar Global, an international real estate development company, have announced the launch of “Marea, interiors by Missoni”, an exclusive residential development project near the Finca Cortesin hotel and golf club, a short walk from the center of Marbella and from the marinas of Puerto Banuìs and Sotogrande, in southern Spain.
The project, curated by the creative director of the Missoni home collection Alberto Caliri with the supervision of Rosita Missoni, represents the second partnership between the brand and Dar Global and involves the construction of a real estate complex of 18,500 square meters with two, three and four apartments rooms. The co-ownership, fenced and equipped with premium security services, will also offer a state-of-the-art gym, an infinity pool, a tennis court and play areas dedicated to children.
“We are delighted to collaborate with Dar Global on the Marea real estate project, interiors by Missoni, and are thrilled to furnish these incredible apartments with the finest fabrics and design, which will give the Mediterranean residences a unique and original finish. Our creative team came together to design bespoke luxury interiors that perfectly fit into the natural environment surrounding the apartments,” said Livio Proli, CEO of Missoni.
Marea, interiors by Missoni is the second project by Dar Global launched in Spain in the last three months, after the ultra luxury villas in Tierra Viva and Benahavis, in June this year.
“We are thrilled to partner with world-renowned fashion brand Missoni and offer exclusive homes in the beautiful landscape of southern Spain. The project has something in store for everyone: from the splendor of the unforgettable golf course of Finca Cortesin, to the golden beaches and dunes of Estepona, all against the backdrop of a breathtaking Mediterranean. This is the second project launched in Spain this year and we are immensely proud to present these unrivaled luxury homes in one of the most sought-after locations in Europe to our internationally traveling clientele,” commented Ziad El Chaar, managing director of Dar Global.
Source: Fashion Network, 30 August 2023, Laura Galbiati.

text:
Exceptional Luxury Living Redefined: DarGlobal And AUTOMOBILI LAMBORGHINI Present TIERRA VIVA VILLAS in the Highly Exclusive BENAHAVIS
21/06/2023
DUBAI, UAE
21st June 2023:
 Prestigious luxury real estate developer DarGlobal unveils its latest and most distinguished project, Tierra Viva. This architectural jewel is set within the ultra-exclusive area of Benahavis, a mere 8-minute drive from the stunning Marbella. The launch of Tierra Viva represents a noteworthy landmark in DarGlobal’s relentless pursuit to deliver incomparable investment opportunities in the luxury segment; the project is valued at approximately 282 million euros. 
An exclusive community with 24/7 premium security, Tierra Viva sits within the gated community of Los Jararillos which hosts 2 gate houses and 24/7 premium security, providing a private and secure environment for its residents and guests. It is home to an array of individual grand villas with panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea that harmoniously blend strength and vitality – a fitting tribute to its name. This architectural gem, inspired by the iconic design of Automobili Lamborghini, marks a significant milestone as the first residential project in Europe with the super sports car brand.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global,
 expressed his pride in the property’s exclusivity, “Tierra Viva represents more than just an exclusive community; it is an emblem of luxury living. At DarGlobal, we have always sought to present the limited-edition of luxury real estate to our discerning clientele. We are delighted to collaborate with Automobili Lamborghini, further broadening our array of luxury brands and delivering the top-tier experience to Spain.”
In the heart of the breathtaking Andalusian hills, every villa is situated at varied elevations, offering residents endless panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea. The community includes three villa designs: 
Diamante (6-bedroom) , Zafiro (5-bedroom),
 and 
Esmeralda (4-bedroom)
. Each villa features direct car access, panoramic swimming pools, multiple terraces, and flourishing gardens, all embellished with polished marble floors, fine leather, and glass elements.
DarGlobal’s alliance with Automobili Lamborghini is an exciting venture. 
Stephan Winkelmann, CEO of Automobili Lamborghini
, remarked, “This partnership represents the merging of Lamborghini’s luxury super sports car essence and DarGlobal’s proficiency in real estate. Tierra Viva embodies the core and power of Lamborghini and its unrestricted nature, interpreted into an architectural masterpiece.”
Benahavis, renowned for its exceptional exclusivity and tranquillity, welcomes this unique property. Its strategic location offers residents effortless access to various landmarks, including the beach, Marbella Club Golf Resort, Puerto Banús, Marbella Club Golden Mile, and the Marbella Marina.
DarGlobal invites you to witness the extraordinary with

 – an epitome of luxury, exclusivity, and architectural innovation.

title: DarGlobal's Agents Event Debuts in Spanish Real Estate
text:
DarGlobal’s Agents Event Paves the Way for a Spectacular Debut in Spanish Real Estate
01/06/2023
DUBAI, UAE
Benahavis, Spain – June 1, 2023 : 
DarGlobal, the premier luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange, announced its official debut in the Spanish market with an inaugural agent briefing event in the ultra-luxurious locale of Benahavis. The briefing event introduced DarGlobal to the key players in the Spanish real estate  industry, with agents from over 100 renowned real estate brokerage firms in attendance.
Based on its distinctive heritage, DarGlobal is set to redefine the landscape of Spain’s luxury real estate and second-homes industry. With operations spanning across the United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Oman, Qatar, Bosnia, and now Spain, DarGlobal has carved out a reputation for its distinguished projects worldwide. Among these are the iconic Urban Oasis Tower by Missoni and DaVinci Tower by Pagani in Dubai, Les Vagues residences by Elie Saab in Doha, the serene SIDRA residences in Bosnia, and the illustrious AIDA master development in Oman, home to a Trump Golf Club, hotel, and residences. These developments testify to DarGlobal’s commitment to excellence and innovative design, setting high expectations for their forthcoming ventures in Spain.
“We are delighted to be debuting our first Spanish project in June, with multiple projects slated for the Costa Del Sol region throughout the year,” said 
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal
. “Our goal is to bring our global expertise in luxury real estate branding to this vibrant market, offering the best-in-class experiences that fuse seamlessly with the rich Spanish culture.”
As a leading developer, Dar Global is renowned for its commitment to quality, innovative design, and strong corporate governance. This move is expected to enhance the property landscape in Spain, bringing the unique and high-quality real estate for which DarGlobal is known.
To stay updated on DarGlobal’s latest launches and developments, visit

تشكل وثيقة شروط وأحكام خدمة الإعلان العقاري هذه ("شروط وأحكام الإعلان") عقداً ملزماً فيما بين شركة وصلت للخدمات العقارية صاحبة سجل تجاري رقم 1 وترخيص وساطة رقم 12 وترخيص منصة رقم 21 ("الشركة") والمُعلن -معرّف أدناه- وتحدد مسؤوليات الطرفين. على المُعلن قراءة الشروط والأحكام بعناية قبل استخدامه للموقع الإلكتروني. ويعني دخوله و/أو استخدامه و/أو الاستفادة من أي خدمة و/أو ميزة و/أو محتوى و/أو منفعة يوفره الموقع الالكتروني أو يتوفر من خلاله، قبولاً من جانب المُعلن بالالتزام بشروط وأحكام الإعلان هذه والشروط والأحكام العامة للاستخدام وسياسة الخصوصية ("الشروط والأحكام") وإقراراً بعلمه علم نافياً للجهالة وموافقته على الالتزام بها.
أولاً: التعريفات
الأنظمة واللوائح المعمول بها: هي اللوائح والأنظمة ذات الصلة النافذة في المملكة العربية السعودية. الإعلان: يقصد به إعلان الوحدة العقارية المدرج على الموقع الإلكتروني والذي ينقسم لعده لفئات مفصله أدناه. الإعلان الرئيسي : هو الإعلان العقاري للوحدة العقارية في الموقع الإلكتروني الذي يتم من خلاله السماح للزائرين بمشاهدته وإبداء اهتماماهم. إعلان مميز: هو الإعلان العقاري للوحدة العقارية في الموقع الإلكتروني والذي يظهر للزائرين عند البحث عن وحدة عقارية بحي أو منطقة معينة. إعلان مميز بلس: هو الإعلان العقاري للوحدة العقارية في الموقع الإلكتروني والذي يظهر للزائرين عند البحث عن وحدة عقارية بحي أو منطقة أو مدينة معينة، كما يظهر كدبوس ذهبي عند استعراض الوحدات العقارية في الخريطة. الرسوم : هي الرسوم التي يدفعها المُعلن بغرض الإعلان عن الوحده عقارية والمفصلة في البند السادس من شروط وأحكام الإعلان هذه. فترة الإعلان: هي الفترة التي يتم من خلالها نشر الإعلان في الموقع الإلكتروني، ومدتها ثلاثون (30) من تاريخ النشر. المُعلن: الشخص الطبيعي والمعنوي الذي يقوم باستخدام الموقع الإلكتروني سواء كان مالكاً للوحدة العقارية أو مفوضاً بالإعلان عنها. الموقع الإلكتروني: موقع "وصلت" ويشمل تطبيق الهاتف الجوال الخاص بنا. الوحدة العقارية: يقصد بها الأرض أو الفلة أو الشقة أو العمارة أو الدور أو الدبلكس أو القصر أو غيره الخاصة بالمُعلن محل الإعلان.

ثانيا: إقرارات والتزامات المُعلن

 يقر ويلتزم المعلن بما يلي:
 بأنه يتمتع بالأهلية المتعبرة نظاماً وشرعاً -في حال كان شخصاً طبيعياً متصرفاً نيابة عن نفسه - وأنه مُنشأ ومُعترف به نظامياً -في حال كان شخصاً اعتبارياً للقيام بالإعلان. كما يقر المُعلن في حال تصرفه نيابة عن غيره أنه مخول ولديه الصلاحية للتصرف نيابة عن شخص آخر سواء طبيعي أم اعتباري. 
 بتحري الصدق والأمانة في الإعلان. 
 بالإبتعاد عن كل ما يسبب التباساً أو تضليلاً للعموم والالتزام بصحة المعلومات المدخلة. 
 بتطبيق ما يصدر به الدليل العام لضوابط المحتوى الإعلاني. 
 بما يصدر من الجهات المختصة بتنظيم المحتوى الأخلاقي والإعلامي بجميع وسائطه المعلوماتية (التقليدية والإلكترونية). 
 باستخدام الأسماء الرسمية للمدن والأحياء والشوارع وأنواع العقارات ويجوز إضافة الأسماء المتعارف عليها. 
 بأن يكون غرض الإعلان للبيع أو التأجير فقط. 
 بمطابقة الصور المدرجة في الإعلان للوحدة العقارية في الواقع. 
 ويفهم بأنه وحده مسؤول عن إدراج الإعلان في الموقع الإلكتروني ومتابعته وتصفحه وتحديثه خلال فترة الإعلان ويدخل من ضمن ذلك تمديد فترة الإعلان الرئيسي. 
 بأنه وحده مسؤول أمام المشتري و/أو المستأجر فيما يتعلق بعدم صحة البيانات والمعلومات المذكورة في الإعلان. 
 بأن الوحدة العقارية سليمة وخالية من العيوب الجوهرية والمخلة بغرض الاستفادة منها، وأنها مستوفيه للتصاريح الرسمية، وأنها غير مقيده بأي اتفاق أو أعباء مالية أو رهن أو نزاعات قد تعيق أو تؤثر على البيع أو الإيجار وفي حال خلاف ذلك فالمعلن يقر بأنه ملزم بالإفصاح عن ذلك بشكل واضح في الإعلان. 
 يحظر نشر الإعلانات العقارية الوهمية لغرض جمع بيانات المتلقين أو العموم أو أي غرض آخر. 
 يوافق المُعلن على دفع رسوم الإعلان للشركة (شركة وصلت للخدمات العقارية) عند تنفيذ أي عملية بيع أو تأجير على

فيلا فاخرة للبيع بتوقيع ELIE SAAB | إيتوال – روشن

في حي سدرة شمال الرياض، ضمن مشروع إيتوال من تطوير دار الأركان. الفيلا جاهزة للسكن، بمساحة أرض 252 م² ومساحة بناء 305 م².

• 4 غرف نوم، منها جناح رئيسي بغرفة ملابس، وصالات عائلية رحبة.

• مطبخ مجهز بالكامل وخزائن راكبة في جميع غرف النوم.

• غرفتان مستقلتان للخادمة والسائق، وغرفة متعددة الاستخدامات.

• تكييف مركزي ونظام منزل ذكي للتحكم بالإضاءة والتكييف.

• نوافذ مزدوجة لعزل الصوت والحرارة، وأرضيات رخام وأسقف جبسية وإضاءة مخفية.

• مواقف مظللة ونظام تسخين مياه مركزي بالطاقة الشمسية.

يوفر الحي حراسة على مدار الساعة ومسارات مشي وجري وحدائق وملاعب للأطفال ومدارس. يبعد الموقع نحو 3 دقائق عن واجهة روشن، و8 دقائق عن جامعة الأميرة نورة، و12 دقيقة عن مطار الملك خالد الدولي، مع سهولة الوصول إلى طرق المطار والثمامة والملك سلمان.

الضمانات تشمل 10 سنوات على الإنشاء وسنة على الكهرباء والميكانيكا.
